endpoints.truth_yaml:
patch_workspaces_policies_archive:
  operationId: archiveOrActivatePolicy
  summary: Archive or reactivate a time-off policy via status field on the policy PATCH endpoint
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-010000-patch.workspaces.policies.archive-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    Spec path /workspaces/{wId}/policies/{policyId}/archive does not exist live.
    The /policies/* root (without 'time-off' prefix) returns Spring-MVC 'No static resource' 404.
    Archive is implemented as PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/policies/{policyId}
    with body {"status": "ARCHIVED"} or {"status": "ACTIVE"} for reactivation.
    Our clockify_time_off_archive tool correctly uses this path.
    Our raw_allowlist_gen.go line 74 lists the non-prefixed path as a spec entry;
    line 130+ covers the actual live time-off prefixed path.
  x-truth-iter: iter17
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: policyId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    description: Use {"status": "ARCHIVED"} to archive or {"status": "ACTIVE"} to reactivate
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [ARCHIVED, ACTIVE]
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Updated policy object
endpoints.notes: LIVE-OVERRIDE: The spec path uses /policies/{policyId}/archive which is absent. Live Clockify achieves archive via the status field on PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/policies/{policyId}. Our tool implementation is correct.
